title: PEOPLE LINES FIT AND GRUDGES READ HOSTILE
why: His order of 2026-10-09: a raid line is a short caps headline of at most 34 letters with a short detail only when needed. With a long name four people headlines ran past 34: NAME IS JOINING THE RAID, NAME ABANDONED THE RAID, NAME CARRIES NOTHING ELSE and NAME WILL REMEMBER THAT. They now read NAME IS JOINING, NAME ABANDONED, NAME EMPTY and NAME WANTS REVENGE. A grudge, a betrayal and the Peddler turning his back were drawn in the teammate blue, so a threat read as a friend; they now use the plain colour. Details that explained are gone: HAND-OVER FAILED names the teammate as its detail, NAME REVIVED YOU and NO DEAL stand alone, THE PEDDLER BOLTS says No trade., and a shot the Bulwark stops says BULWARK SHIELD with Flank it.
now: People lines fit the headline length and grudges no longer show in the teammate colour.
